**Issue #3571 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3571: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S25, the seven AI cards
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It scripts the seven AI cards the foundation designed (SP7), and puts them in the Marketplace's AI lot.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP7, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

## Cards

T-AI-1 to T-AI-7 of Stinkyscape+, as the foundation's table in SP7 gives them: 2 Fruit, 2 Jlockeed, 2 CN and 1 KY, each also tagged AI and Token.

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): the seven catalog entries, designed in SP7, and their stub scripts.
- S15 (#3566) and S16 (#3553): the Fruit and Jlockeed verbs they may use.
- The Marketplace's AI lot (R1000, R1853000; `docs/stinkyscape-set.md` ST15).

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
* **New AI Cards, (Should have tags)**
  * Create 2 New AI cards that are also fruits
  * Create 2 New AI cards that Jlockeed
  * Create 2 New AI cards that are CN
  * Create 1 New AI card that is KY
```

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- They follow ST15's constraints (`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`): (0) to (2), no Credits made, one system each, unique names, no numbers declared outside `params.rs`, and each Radiant face doubling a number or adding a rider (R275).
- The Marketplace offers them in its AI lot once the set ships, as it offers Stinkyscape's ten. The AI lot's odds don't change.

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text, in its own script file, with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers.
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout. The Marketplace's tests show the seven in its AI lot once the set ships.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited, and the set stays `Held` until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3566, #3553

Part of #3534.
````
